output.reason: The brief is convincing. It uses specific figures to tie the timing of the FCR drop to the Finance credit-limit change: referrals rose from 7% to 54%, referred calls resolve at about 33%, and FCR fell by the same amount across tenure bands. That fits the agent comment about bills now going to BRT, rules out the IVR change on timing, and leads to a clear trial and a clear call against the performance plans, though I can't check the figures myself.
